name: ab-test-significance-calculator
description: Calculates statistical significance of A/B test results using a two-tailed z-test for difference in proportions. Returns confidence level, z-score, p-value, relative lift, and a pass/fail/borderline verdict.

controlVisitors.description: Number of visitors in control group (A)

controlConversions.description: Number of conversions in control group (A)

variantVisitors.description: Number of visitors in variant group (B)

variantConversions.description: Number of conversions in variant group (B)
